list.title: Commands
list.description: Reusable instructions for the things you do often.
list.runOff: Turn on the command to run it
list.emptyDescription: Save instructions you use often, then run them from the task panel or a shortcut.
list.reorderHint: Press and hold a command to drag it into place, or move the focused one with ⌥↑ and ⌥↓.
list.deleteDescription: This removes the command and its shortcut. Existing tasks keep their saved command version.

editor.label: Command editor
editor.pluginNotice: Provided by plugin {{plugin}}. Duplicate to customize.
editor.name: Name
editor.parametersHint: Add reusable fields to this command’s input form.
editor.deletedError: This command was deleted. Cancel and create a new command to keep a copy.

validation.selectionDisabled: Turn on the selected text variable in Input options to use this source.
validation.clipboardDisabled: Turn on the clipboard variable in Input options to use this source.
validation.filesDisabled: Turn on Allow attached files in Input options to use this source.
validation.textNotAccepted: A command without text input can’t require text. Turn off Require text input.
validation.duplicateKey: Each parameter needs a unique variable key.
validation.optionIncomplete: Every option needs a label and a value.

parameters.subtitle: {{name}} · Parameters
parameters.label: Label
parameters.keyHint: Used by saved inputs and instructions.
parameters.optionsHint: Keep values stable; labels can change without changing saved input.
parameters.errorKey: Use letters, numbers, and underscores; start with a letter.
parameters.errorDuplicateKey: This variable key is already used.
parameters.errorOptions: Every option needs a label and a unique value.

placement.title: Show in

selectionToolbar.title: Selection toolbar in other apps
selectionToolbar.description: Runs on text you select in another app.

turnSelection.title: Selection toolbar in conversations
turnSelection.description: Runs on text you select in an answer.

turnActions.title: Turn actions
turnActions.description: Runs on a turn’s answer, from its More actions menu.

placement.unavailable: To show this command in these places, have it read the selected text: set Input source to Selected text, or turn on the selected text variable in Input options.

output.title: Result

panel.title: Show in the conversation
panel.description: The answer stays in the conversation.

replaceSelection.title: Replace the selected text
replaceSelection.description: Writes the answer over the text you selected.

insertAfterSelection.title: Insert after the selected text
insertAfterSelection.description: Writes the answer after the text you selected, keeping that text.

insertAtCursor.title: Insert at the cursor
insertAtCursor.description: Types the answer where the cursor was.

copy.title: Copy to the clipboard
copy.description: Also puts the answer on the clipboard.

output.writeBackNote: Writes only when the command runs from another app, through its shortcut or the selection toolbar. Anywhere else, the answer stays in the conversation.
output.cardNote: If that app can’t take text there, the answer shows in a card for you to copy.

review.title: Review before applying
review.description: The answer waits in the conversation until you write it with its Replace in or Insert in button.

output.needsTarget: Nothing is written back from here: the answer stays in the conversation. Writing back needs a run from another app, through the command's shortcut or the selection toolbar.
output.needsSelection: This command doesn't read the selected text, so the answer stays in the conversation.

typing.description: Answers appear a few characters at a time. Turn off to paste them at once.
typing.reduceMotion: Reduce Motion is on in System Settings, so answers appear all at once.
typing.label: Typing effect
typing.scope: How commands write their answers into other apps.

errors.save: The typing effect couldn't be saved. Try again.

typingAnimation.label: Highlight new text
typingAnimation.description: A glow at the insertion point and a brief highlight behind the new text, whether it is typed in or pasted at once.
typingAnimation.reduceMotion: Reduce Motion is on in System Settings, so the new text is highlighted without the moving glow.

errors.save: The new-text highlight couldn't be saved. Try again.

shortcut.error: Include Command, Control, or Alt with a supported key.
shortcut.conflictHint: If it does nothing, another app may hold this combination. Choose a different one.

registration.unavailable: This global shortcut is unavailable. Choose another combination.
registration.invalid: This shortcut cannot be registered on this Mac. Choose another combination.
registration.doubleTapAccessibility: Double-tap shortcuts need app control access. Allow Atd in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Device Control and Data Access (Accessibility on earlier macOS versions).
registration.tooMany: Too many command shortcuts are set to register them all. Remove a shortcut you no longer use.

row.sameAsCommand: Same as the toolbar and Run button

list.limit: A command can have up to {{max}} shortcuts.
list.title: Shortcuts
list.emptyDescription: Record keys to run this command from any app.

page.subtitle: {{name}} · Shortcuts
page.keysDescription: Press them in any app to run this command with the settings below.
page.name: Name
page.overridesDescription: Anything left on Follow command changes when the command does.
page.footerNote: To use different instructions, input or tools, duplicate the command from its More menu in the command list.

problem.invalidKeys: These keys can’t be used as a shortcut. Record another combination.
problem.heldByAction: “{{action}}” already uses these keys. Choose another combination.
problem.heldBySelectionToolbar: The selection toolbar’s double-tap already uses these keys. Choose another combination.
problem.heldByCommand: The command “{{name}}” already uses these keys. Choose another combination.
problem.heldBySameCommand: This command’s shortcut “{{name}}” already uses these keys. Choose another combination.
problem.pinnedValue: {{label}}: the value this shortcut sets isn’t valid anymore. Edit the shortcut to choose another.
problem.outputUnavailable: This shortcut’s result works on selected text, which the command no longer reads. Edit the shortcut to choose another result.

instruction.title: Instructions
instruction.hint: Type / for skills, @ for subagents, MCP servers and conversations, and {{ for variables.
instruction.tooManySkills: Instructions can load at most {{max}} skills.
instruction.tooManyReferences: Instructions can mention at most {{max}} subagents, MCP servers and conversations.

session.opened: Opened a new AI session in the task panel.
session.enableSkill: Enable {{name}} in Extensions → Skills before creating with AI.

io.title: Input and result
io.description: What a run reads and where its answer goes.
io.composeNote: Run from its shortcut with nothing selected, it asks you to type the text.
io.composeCursorNote: Run from its shortcut with nothing selected, it asks you to type the text and puts the answer at the cursor.

start.title: Launch
start.description: The shortcut that runs it and where else it’s offered.

run.title: Run settings
run.description: The model, effort, memory and tools each run may use.
run.thinkingLevelHint: How much the model reasons before it answers, whichever model runs the command. Lower is faster and cheaper. Each run adjusts the level to what its model supports.
run.memoryInherit: Use memory · Follow global learning setting
run.memoryOff: Off for this task and follow-ups

variables.inputDetail: Main text · chosen when the command runs
variables.selectionDetail: Selected text · captured before the panel opens
variables.clipboardDetail: Clipboard text · only captured when requested
